subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu preserve omitted allowBots as accept-by-default for bot-authored events, or require an explicit bot-admission setting before this feature lands?
rationale: The PR's default preserves the contributor's current-behavior claim for Feishu, but it changes the documented config surface and differs from the stricter posture used by sibling channels, so automation should not choose that product policy alone.

options.title: Preserve Feishu Accept-By-Default
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu events and rely on self-filtering plus botLoopProtection as the upgrade guard.

options.title: Require Explicit Bot Admission
options.body: Change the default to ignore bot-authored Feishu events unless allowBots is true or "mentions", aligning with stricter sibling-channel posture at the cost of not preserving current Feishu admission behavior.

options.title: Defer Bot-To-Bot Support
options.body: Pause or close the PR until maintainers define a broader cross-channel bot-admission policy.

recommendation.title: Preserve Feishu Accept-By-Default
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu events and rely on self-filtering plus botLoopProtection as the upgrade guard.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the related Feishu mention-cascade fix and has recent Feishu/channel policy history, making them the best available owner for the default-policy call.
